calibration_contrast_predictive_tail.scope: Bayesian predictive check conditional on the released Gaussian model and CMB/BAO factorization, with calibrator values excluded from the fitted density. For the fixed common-calibration linear contrast, F=sum w*Phi(v^Tt/sigma); the equal-tail area is2min(F,1-F), not the average of component two-sided areas. The full conditional77D log predictive density has units mag^-77. Neither statistic is a calibrated frequentist significance, raw-data blind test or validation of the unresolved released covariance construction. A common brightness contrast does not test every possible residual pattern.
